summary: Diana Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 16, 2026, announcing that a wholly-owned subsidiary entered a time charter contract with Aquavita International S.A. for the Kamsarmax dry bulk vessel m/v Astarte, an 81,513 dwt ship built in 2013. The gross rate is US$17,000 per day less 4.75% third-party commission, running from about September 20, 2026 until minimum September 1, 2027 and maximum November 15, 2027, replacing a prior charter to Propel Shipping at US$12,500 per day. Expected gross revenue is roughly US$5.81 million over the minimum period. This is a routine commercial charter, not a special situation.
